server_waypoint.config.render_waypoints_: Show in-world waypoints while F1 hides the HUD. Waypoints remain hidden during loading screens.
server_waypoint.config.xaero_default_lis:
Off: sync gui.xaero_default to a separate server-owned set.

On: replace the contents of Xaero's default set, including personal waypoints. Applies on the next sync; other lists always use separate sets.
